title: Te Mea Whiriwhiri Mārama
intro: I raro i te atarangi o te maunga i heke iho ai ngā kupu tapu, ka ngohengohe te whakapono o te iwi i raro i te kanapa o te koura. Kotahi te wairua, he pūkenga kōrero, i tū hei tautoko i tētahi misioni nui ake, engari i tūtaki ki tētahi wā whakamātautau nui. I te taenga o te karere i whiriwhiria ki tētahi wā tapu, i noho tonu tēnei tangata ki muri, e inoi ana ki tētahi iwi e kore e okioki. Ko wai tēnei wairua u e ara ake ana tōna reo ki te karakia whakapakoko?
clues: I whiriwhiria ahau e Allah hei poropiti, ahakoa he maha ngā wā ka kōrerotia taku kōrero i te taha o tētahi atu.
I tukuna ahau ki tētahi rangatira nanakia, engari ko taku mahi he tautoko, ehara i te ārahi.
He pūkenga kōrero pai tōku, ā, ko te tikanga o aku kupu he whakangawari i ngā ngākau.
I te haerenga atu o tōku hoa mō tētahi hui tapu, i mahue iho ahau hei ārahi i tētahi iwi e noho pōrearea ana.
I roto i tō rātou manawanui kore, i hangaia e rātou he whakapakoko mai i ā rātou whakapaipai, ā, i inoi ahau ki a rātou kia noho pono ki a Allah.
I hoki mai taku hoa, ā, ka hopu i ahau, engari i whakamārama atu ahau i kaha rawa te iwi ki ahau, ā, tata tonu ahau te patu i ahau; kāore ahau i roto i te hunga hara.

trial.answer: Te aro atu ki te kaupapa o te kuao kau koura

arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verse: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people. (10:75)
